subject: ADA Self-Evaluation and Transition Plan Update
overview: The Commission for Persons with Disabilities received an update on the city's ADA self-evaluation survey and reviewed plans for accessible pedestrian signal installations. The commission also voted to invite a Community Development Board representative to a future meeting to discuss accessibility considerations in city rezoning.

items.title: ADA Self-Evaluation and Transition Plan Update
items.summary: Representatives from the Institute for Human Centered Design presented an update on accessibility surveys conducted across municipal buildings, schools, parks, sidewalks, and the city website.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the September 2026 meeting minutes.

items.title: Accessible Pedestrian Signals Update
items.summary: Staff detailed a grant-funded project to install 42 accessible pedestrian signal buttons across six intersections by June 2027.

items.title: Early Voting Information
items.summary: Commissioners and staff reviewed early voting schedules at City Hall and noted accessible options for dropping off mail-in ballots.

items.title: Community Development and Rezoning Motion
items.summary: The commission approved a motion to invite a representative from the Community Development Board to present on city rezoning plans and accessibility impacts.

items.title: Announcements
items.summary: Staff announced a sensory-friendly Halloween party at City Hall and an ongoing winter clothing collection drive.
